column2: command run with docker exec after docker start (the recipe's own launch step)

/liveimap-reseed && { export PATH=/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:$PATH; sed -i 's/^\t#idled\t\tcmd="idled"/\tidled\t\tcmd="idled"/' /etc/cyrus.conf; sed -i 's/^idlemethod: poll/idlemethod: idled/' /etc/imapd.conf; rm -f /var/run/cyrus-master.pid /run/cyrus-master.pid /var/run/cyrmaster.pid; setsid /usr/sbin/cyrmaster -d </dev/null >/tmp/cyrmaster.out 2>&1; }

/liveimap-reseed && { export PATH=/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:$PATH; sed -i 's/^\t#idled\t\tcmd="idled"/\tidled\t\tcmd="idled"/' /etc/cyrus.conf; sed -i 's/^idlemethod: poll/idlemethod: idled/' /etc/imapd.conf; rm -f /var/run/cyrus-master.pid /run/cyrus-master.pid /var/run/cyrmaster.pid; setsid /usr/sbin/cyrmaster -d </dev/null >/tmp/cyrmaster.out 2>&1; }
/liveimap-reseed && if [ -x /etc/init.d/openbsd-inetd ]; then setsid /etc/init.d/openbsd-inetd start </dev/null >/tmp/inetd.out 2>&1; else setsid /usr/sbin/inetd </dev/null >/tmp/inetd.out 2>&1; fi

[ -S /dev/log ] && [ -f /var/run/rsyslogd.pid ] && [ -d /proc/$(cat /var/run/rsyslogd.pid) ] || { rm -f /var/run/rsyslogd.pid; rsyslogd 2>/dev/null; }; p=/run/imapd.pid; if ! { [ -f $p ] && [ -d /proc/$(cat $p) ]; }; then rm -f $p; /usr/lib/courier-imap/libexec/imapd.rc start; fi; true
